dedupe_keys.name: ireland epa industrial emissions directive ied licensed installations inspire point dataset

description: Point locations of the sites licensed under the Industrial Emissions Directive in Ireland. The data.gov.ie entry says it is a point dataset of IED site facility locations, and that the EPA is the competent authority for granting and enforcing IED licences for the industrial and agricultural activities listed in the First Schedule to the Environmental Protection Agency Act 1992 as amended. It is served through an INSPIRE WMS view service and an ATOM download service, with the EPA GIS site as the home page, free under CC BY 4.0; the portal metadata were modified on 25 September 2026. Coverage is the Republic of Ireland. Caveats: locations only in the entry read, with licence details and emissions held elsewhere at the EPA. For simulation it places licensed industrial and intensive agricultural sites for flood, fire and pollution exposure models. A related catalogue record is the European Industrial Emissions Portal.
